title: Slain driver had run-ins with cops
article: Court documents show that a man killed by police near Brockville had previous run-ins with the law.
The Special Investigations Unit has identified the victim in the Friday incident as 35-year-old Phillip Jeffrey Charbonneau.
Court records show he had not made any payments on a $5,000 fine received in October 2008 for driving while his licence was suspended.
In April 2007, he was convicted of careless driving and fined $320 and twice convicted of speeding in early 2008.
On Friday at about 11 p.m., OPP officers shot and killed Charbonneau after he allegedly struck an officer with a pickup truck.
The incident followed a chase after police say Charbonneau bolted from a RIDE check on a Hwy. 401 off-ramp in Brockville.
